mentions.name: Saasie
mentions.description: Agentic infrastructure for deploying very small production apps en masse. Deployed app units are called 'saasies'. The infrastructure is designed with agents as the primary users, covering deployment, databases, domains, secrets, observability, and lifecycle management, so that anybody can deploy an app.
mentions.audience: Agents are the primary users; the goal is that everybody and their pet can deploy an app.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on agentic infrastructure for deploying very small production apps en masse.

In particular, I’m exploring what the infrastructure should look like when agents are the primary users: deployment, databases, domains, secrets, observability, and lifecycle management.

The goal is that everybody and their pet can deploy an app.

These units are called saasies, and the project is Saasie.
